name: Xylophone
instruction: I need you to create a 3D model of a xylophone. The xylophone should have a series of rectangular bars arranged in ascending order of size, each representing different musical notes. The bars should be mounted on a frame and struck with mallets to produce sound. Ensure the frame is sturdy and the bars are evenly spaced.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a xylophone.
The xylophone consists of a series of rectangular bars.
The bars are arranged in ascending order of size.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The bars are proportionate to the xylophone.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The bars are correctly positioned on the frame.
The ascending size of the bars is visually clear.
The mallets are positioned appropriately for use.
Object distance and contact: There is no overlap between the bars.
The bars are securely mounted on the frame.
The mallets are within reach of the bars.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
The arrangement of bars follows the ascending order of size.
The frame is designed to be sturdy as instructed.
